notes.title: Capybara is Coming! Official Release on August 30, 2024
notes.notes:
Attention all gamers! 🎮

We are thrilled to announce that our new game, Capybara, will be available on [b]August 30, 2024[/b]. Get ready for a clicker adventure like no other!

This week, we've added exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience:

[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide and prove who is the best!
[*] Idle System: Now you can earn points automatically when you reopen the game after being away. Don't miss a single moment!
[*] 5 New Items: Explore and discover the new items we've added to help you on your journey to the top.
[/list]
Mark your calendar and join us in this fun and addictive adventure with Capybara. See you on August 30!
